name: Yatagarasu — the Kasugai Kit
description: The whole Yatagarasu kit in one place: the dispatch-scroll notification design (in Notifications) and the Roost (in Plugins) — the crow herself on your desktop, her eye wearing the freshest word. The scrolls are her voice. Install both halves and she is whole.

items.name: yatagarasu-roost
items.summary: The Kasugai crow roosting on the desktop, her eye wearing the last notification's priority colour — install from the Plugins tab; the kit's other half, the scroll design, lives in Notifications.
